column_description: Unique identifier for each machine learning model.
Name of the machine learning model. may be NULL.
Type of the machine learning model (e.g., regression, classification). always exactly one of 'regression', 'classification'. may be NULL.
Algorithm used for training the model. may be NULL.
Date the model was trained. may be NULL.
Accuracy of the model. may be NULL.
Description of the model. may be NULL.
